purpose: Document separate English/local-language source discovery, land-registry custody, anonymous request outcomes and safe geometry limits.
assessment: HM Land Registry distributes monthly GML INSPIRE Index Polygons per local authority; the polygons are indicative extents of registered freehold property and a subset of all title index polygons. Brighton & Hove download was parsed in full; exact WUP point matched zero features. No title identifiers or owner attributes were retained.
